maddeler.e:
نتعاقب (form VI)
# نَتَعَاقَبُ (nataʕāqabu) /na.ta.ʕaː.qa.bu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَعَاقَبَ (taʕāqaba)
# نَتَعَاقَبَ (nataʕāqaba) /na.ta.ʕaː.qa.ba/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَعَاقَبَ (taʕāqaba)
# نَتَعَاقَبْ (nataʕāqab) /na.ta.ʕaː.qab/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَعَاقَبَ (taʕāqaba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
